name: Players
author: Citizen Score
description: Look up any AION 2 character on the Global servers: combat power, item level, stats, gear and Arcana, skills and stigmas, and every Daevanion board node by node. Lists the players around you with a hover card of their gear and combat power, and a card over the game for whoever you fight. Asks NCSOFT's own character site, only when you search, hover or fight.
